transforms.convention: T_A_B maps column-vector coordinates in B to coordinates in A
transforms.rig: C_right(t) = M @ C_left(t); M is published original-axis left_to_right

representations.free_registration_scale: diagnostic only; rejected by fixed-world conversion and scoring

identity_and_time.object_membership: Match GT by name; use kit slot order for evaluated artifacts
identity_and_time.frame_index: Original source frame ID, never an output-row ordinal
identity_and_time.timestamp: Source capture time when supplied; null means unavailable, never measured zero
identity_and_time.matching: Episode/frame/camera axes must match; supplied timestamps must agree
identity_and_time.independent_benchmark: Freeze frame-to-capture-time correspondence and input hashes before evaluation

camera_provenance.shared_camera: Exactly one immutable camera record/path/SHA-256 per episode/source frame for every object
camera_provenance.gt_assisted: Camera fitting or observation selection uses object GT; diagnostic lane only
camera_provenance.independent: Metric background/stereo camera producer with no object-trajectory GT
camera_provenance.require_independent: Reject unknown/GT-assisted camera provenance and GT-dependent native observations
camera_provenance.constant_alignment: Official start alignment removes one rigid gauge; it does not remove camera motion or scale errors

observations.observed: Raw accepted observation; final residual and temporal gates also pass
observations.rejected: Retained in diagnostics; excluded from observation exports and propagation
observations.inferred: Explicit fill/filter result; does not count as raw observation coverage
observations.smoothing: Off by default; immutable input snapshot, no gap filling, final residuals recomputed
observations.depth: Invalid pixels require a validity mask; triangulate in rectified coordinates with P1/P2/Q
observations.mesh: All active visual-scene geometry, node transforms and original uncentered scan origin retained
observations.outputs: Fresh destination; preserve historical inputs, predictions and reports

scoring.shape_metric: CD-O is separate Sim(3)-aligned shape scoring
scoring.gaps: Preserve raw/fill masks; any hold/backfill is explicit in diagnostic reports
scoring.missing_measurements: null with a reason, never a successful zero error
scoring.original_general_target: All 20 public reports; visible medians <5 cm and <5 degrees
scoring.original_pot_target: Both ego_cam_b and ego_cam_c; medians <10 cm and <10 degrees plus residual explanation
scoring.cross_object_target: Report every kit pair and identify the issue's unavailable seventeenth configuration

asset_free_fallback.note: Retain masks/depth/cameras for the existing planned asset-free reconstruction path when CAD is unavailable
asset_free_fallback.limitations: Missing CAD cannot be silently replaced by another object's mesh or counted as a successful CAD fit
asset_free_fallback.implementation_and_real_validation: Separate dependency; not claimed complete by these repairs
